annotations.title: Boost your strongest organic posts automatically

description: Create an automation that, every day or week, puts ad money behind the brand's best ORGANIC posts on Facebook or Instagram: it reads the brand's own measured posts, picks up to maxPostsPerRun from the last maxAgeDays that clear the bars you set (engagement rate, engagements, views) and boosts each at boost.dailyBudget for boost.days, from adAccountId (a Meta ad account shared with this brand). launch review (default): each boost is built PAUSED and its activation waits in Needs review for a person; launch live: each goes live on its own, inside the ceiling confirmed when switching it on. It is created OFF; switch it on with set_automation_status (confirm-gated on its spend ceiling). test_automation shows which posts it would boost now. Free to set up; the boosts spend the ad account's money.

adAccountId.description: the Meta ad account that pays

boost.description: {dailyBudget (ad account currency), days (default 3), countries (optional ISO codes), minPostAgeMinutes (default 120)}

every.description: how often it checks, default daily

filter.description: {minEngagementRate (percent of views), minEngagements, minViews, maxAgeDays (default 7), maxPostsPerRun (default 1)}; at least one bar

name: create_boost_automation
title: Boost your strongest organic posts automatically
